data.name: All and None
data.description: Instead of choosing a single energy to gain resistance against and dictate the energy ray racial psi-like ability, you use your active energy type. If you do not have an energy ray racial psi-like ability or racial energy resistance, this ability provides no benefit. Regardless, your chitin changes color to match your current active energy type, red for fire, blue for cold, white for sonic, and green for electricity.
